pressure_hypothesis.title: ECI compaction can hide verified record-correction provenance
pressure_hypothesis.basis: The bounded campaign window verified five records but compacted four rows and omitted the correction row and correction counts, so this response did not expose whether the target-to-correction relationship was applied.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: When response compaction retains a linked campaign path, preserve bounded append-only record-correction counts and exact target and correction evidence references so agents can inspect how the projected definition was established.
pressure_hypothesis.recurrence: one selected campaign-window response; recurrence across other response shapes or sessions is not established
not_measured: agent time or tool calls caused by the omitted correction details
frequency of correction-summary omission across other evidence windows
whether the omission changed a development decision

measurement_limits: The selected campaign ledger contained a correction record, but this compact response did not establish its application status or expose its explicit provenance summary.
This records one selected response only and does not establish agent intervention burden, recurring failure, or causal impact.
